kind: Independent source-only review of ready-row context regression suite
result: No source-level blocker found; actual original-product overlay and candidate AOT runs remain required
observations: The second row of a three-row single batch reaches the ready branch, after initial MoveAsync populated _transport and _batch.
SynchronousContext is a synchronous test helper and checks caller context immediately after MoveNextAsync, before consuming the ValueTask; an outer async builder cannot mask leakage.
NegativeControls proves ordinary synchronous mapping leaks AsyncLocal/SynchronizationContext and ValueTask.FromException(OperationCanceledException) is faulted rather than canceled.
Both flow suppression states and plain exception/OCE with and without token are covered; failure object identity and cleanup entry mapper context are observed.

DelayedCleanup covers mapper error/cancellation with successful/failed native retirement, move and Dispose completion fences, public synchronous admission error priority, original error annotation and shared cleanup failure.
DisposeDuringReadyMapping holds the admitted second mapper on a worker while Dispose waits, verifying the native batch stays active and the admitted owned result remains available.
The 32-row case uses [32,0] batches and the 33-row case [32,1], covering full-batch EOF and next-batch materialization; quota checks verify no second mapper executes before buffered admission.
